summary: This code creates a diagram showing a team structure using AWS architecture icons. It visualizes how an entity named 'Olivier' (represented as a load balancer) connects to five team members (represented as EC2 instances) who all feed into a shared database called 'Work together'. The diagram is created but not displayed on screen.

explanations.6: The 'with' statement creates a diagram context; 'show=False' means the diagram won't pop up automatically, and 'direction="TB"' means it flows top-to-bottom.
explanations.8: ELB creates a load balancer icon labeled 'Olivier' — in this case used to represent a person/role rather than an actual AWS load balancer.
explanations.9: The '>>' operator chains these elements together to show data flow; the square brackets create a list of five EC2 instances that all sit between Olivier and the database, representing five team members.
explanations.10: RDS represents a relational database labeled 'Work together', which is the final destination of the data flow from all team members.
